results.intentUsed:
Exercise the licence catalogue, team-size input, remember option, plan selection, pagination, and quote request. Report exact visible rows, values, validation feedback, and any unreachable or clipped controls.

Work through these checks in order, and record what you actually observe for each:
1. Select a plan on page 1, then navigate to page 2 and back with Previous. Then Read the selected row and quote summary after returning to page 1. — expect: The selected plan and its quote summary must remain unchanged.
2. Use a narrow mobile-sized viewport on /licences. Then Inspect the catalogue table while scrolling horizontally and vertically. — expect: Every column and each Select control must be readable and reachable without clipping.
3. Enable remembering and enter 17 seats. Then Click Shipping estimate, return to /licences, and reread the team-size field. — expect: The team-size field must still show 17 after returning.
4. Select Team Annual and enter 4 seats. Then Read the quote section and its request control. — expect: A visible four-seat minimum message must appear and Request quote must be disabled.
